verdicts.title: Cylindrical Algebraic Decompositions for Boolean Combinations
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This article makes the key observation that when using cylindrical algebraic decomposition (CAD) to solve a problem with respect to a set of polynomials, it is not always the signs of those polynomials that are of paramount importance but rather the truth values of certain quantifier free formulae involving them. This motivates our definition of a Truth Table Invariant CAD (TTICAD). We generalise the theory of equational constraints to design an algorithm which will efficiently construct a TTICA
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses Cylindrical Algebraic Decomposition for Boolean combinations of polynomial constraints — it shares vocabulary (Boolean, algebraic) but says nothing about minimal orders of algebraic integers or CNF clause complexity bounds like O(m^(1/3) * n^(2/3)).

verdicts.title: Stuttering blocks of Ariki-Koike algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study a shift action defined on multipartitions and on residue multisets of their Young diagrams. We prove that the minimal orbit cardinality among all multipartitions associated to a given multiset depends only on the orbit cardinality of the multiset. Using abaci, this problem reduces to a convex optimisation problem over the integers with linear constraints. verdicts.title: An Extreme Family of Generalized Frobenius Numbers
